alt: Hand-sketched isometric of The Rose v0.52: red amphitheater petals around a crown lounge, the tall jump petal, the fallen-petal slide, the stem walkway with compound leaves, people on the decks, on the river.
caption: Four layers pulled apart vertically: float and seating, petal walls, terrace roofs, flue. Dashed verticals mark where the layers join, in the clefts between petals. Pink dots are terrace guests, 8 to 10 per petal.

key.d: The chimney is the center of the flower. Heat source is still open: custom EOS gas was the 9/26 call, but Parks fuel rules may force electric.
Each petal roof is a flat terrace for 8 to 10 people, about 40 outside between rounds.
Set in the clefts where petals overlap, none beside the bridge petal.
Three stadium tiers step down to the fire, about 57 inside.
Twelve steel stamens fan up and out from the heater, stones clustered along them.
Spirals off a petal terrace into the river.
Swim-out landings tied to the slide by short petiole walkways.
Small and dark, 6 to 8 people, on its own float.
Faceted or convex, never smooth arcs, so the round room does not focus sound.
Petals stay inside the float edge. Edge freeboard, not heel, is what limits crowd on the roofs.

layers.d: Wide circular float, sunken fire pit, three tiers per petal.
